name: Nago
source: Nago is [url=/c25640]Rachel's[/url] black, transmogrifying cat that speaks and acts just as snobbishly as her. He is often seen in umbrella form, but he can also morph into (and be used as) either a Lobelia (bat lance), a cannon, or a chair. It is possible that Nago is homosexual, due to his comments on [url=/c25639]Jin[/url] and [url=/c26475]Hakumen[/url], such as "Just seeing a hot man in chains just makes me…" and saying that Jin is "just his type" much to Gii's discomfort and in Chronophantasma he states that [url=/c30640]Amane[/url] is "a cutie pie".
